name: Flowbite 4
licence: Core library MIT (npm flowbite@4.0.2). Flowbite Pro blocks/Figma are commercial (not studied).
bestFor: admin panels and CRUD back-offices on any server stack (vanilla JS data-attributes)
teams moving from Bootstrap who want named components
avoidFor: distinctive marketing pages (blue-700 + Inter + 12px radius is the stock AI look)
dense pro apps (42px default controls, ring-4 focus halos)

typography.notes: Overrides Tailwind leading tokens in px (leading-4 16, -5 20, -6 24, -7 28, -8 32, -9 36, heading-none 60) and tracking in px (tight -0.4px, tighter -0.8px; mono theme sets tracking-normal -0.4px). px tracking does not scale with size (a 48px heading at -0.8px is only -0.017em). Body colour gray-600, heading gray-900.

color.model: oklch (role aliases over the Tailwind palette)

accents.default brand: blue-700 (hover brand-strong blue-800; soft blue-100; softer blue-50; dark brand blue-600)

semantic.extra hues: purple, sky, teal, pink, cyan, fuchsia, indigo, orange

color.darkMode: .dark class re-maps every alias (neutral-primary -> gray-950, brand -> blue-600, success-soft -> emerald-950).
color.contrastNotes: gray-600 body on white passes AA; white text on blue-700 passes AA. Status 'soft' backgrounds (emerald-50, rose-50) carry -strong (900) text.

radius.rule: Buttons and inputs use rounded-base (12px default). Themes change radius only: enterprise 1-4px, minimal 2-16px, mono 1px everywhere, playful 10-20px (base 20px).

shadows: shadow-xs on buttons and inputs (Tailwind 0 1px 2px rgb(0 0 0/.05))
shadow-sm / shadow-lg on cards and modals

motion.notes: duration-200/300 on accordions, drawers, modals (counted from docs markup). Focus = focus:ring-4 with a soft tint of the variant colour (brand-medium blue-200).

controlHeightsPx.computation: leading-5 (20px) + 2 x py + 2px border; computed from docs classes, not measured

components.stateMatrixCompleteness: Medium: hover, focus (ring-4), disabled, success/error input states shown; pressed and loading states thin; keyboard behaviour via flowbite.js data attributes.

tokenArchitecture: Two layers: Tailwind palette primitives -> ~100 semantic aliases named by role and intensity (neutral-primary-soft/-medium/-strong, brand-softer/soft/medium/strong, fg-*, border default-subtle/default/strong). Five theme files swap the alias targets, fonts and radii.
distinctiveness: Low. Its value is breadth and the alias naming grid (role x intensity); visually it is the canonical 'Tailwind admin template'.
weaknesses: Default look (Inter, blue-700, 12px radius, ring-4 halo) is the most generic SaaS grammar
Many aliases map to the same value in light mode (neutral-primary-soft/primary/medium/strong all white): naming implies a range that does not exist
px tracking and px leading do not scale
takeaways: A whole theme can be fonts + radius + one brand hue + neutral family; Flowbite's five themes show how far that alone moves personality (serif enterprise vs Shantell playful).
Name aliases by role x intensity (soft/medium/strong) so dark mode can re-map each independently.
provenance: mixed (theme CSS from npm flowbite@4.0.2; control sizes computed from public docs markup)
